# Flashwise — llms.txt

> Flashwise is a free flashcard platform for fast memorization: 3D flip
> cards, adaptive Learn mode, 5-layer spaced repetition SRS and a progress
> dashboard. Create a study set in 1 minute, study on web and mobile.

Flashwise là nền tảng flashcard miễn phí: thẻ lật 3D, học thích ứng Learn,
lặp lại ngắt quãng SRS 5 tầng và dashboard tiến độ. Tạo học phần trong 1 phút.

## Canonical

- Home (vi): https://flashwise.app/
- Home (en): https://flashwise.app/en
- Home (zh): https://flashwise.app/zh
- Home (ja): https://flashwise.app/ja
- Home (ko): https://flashwise.app/ko
- Full context: https://flashwise.app/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://flashwise.app/sitemap.xml

## Core tools (4 live)

- Flashcards 3D: flip, shuffle, autoplay, fullscreen, hints, pronunciation.
  Home: https://flashwise.app/
  Tool: https://flashwise.app/tools/flashcards
- Learn (adaptive): MCQ 4 options, true/false, written recall, instant
  grading, SRS scheduling per card.
  Tool: https://flashwise.app/tools/learn
- SRS 5 layers: Not studied > Learning > Familiar > Reviewing > Mastered.
  Daily due banner, streak keeping.
  Tool: https://flashwise.app/tools/srs
- Progress: mastery rate, 4-state distribution, retention score, dues.
  Tool: https://flashwise.app/tools/progress

## Roadmap (notify at launch)

- Test mode: https://flashwise.app/tools/test
- Study groups: https://flashwise.app/tools/groups
- Live class: https://flashwise.app/tools/live

## FAQ (short)

- Q: Flashwise là gì?
  A: Nền tảng flashcard miễn phí: thẻ 3D, Learn thích ứng, SRS 5 tầng,
  dashboard tiến độ. Tạo học phần trong 1 phút.
- Q: Flashwise có miễn phí không?
  A: Có, toàn bộ tính năng cốt lõi miễn phí, đăng ký chỉ cần email.
- Q: What is Flashwise?
  A: A free flashcard platform: 3D cards, adaptive Learn, 5-layer SRS,
  progress dashboard. Create a set in 1 minute.
- Q: Is Flashwise free?
  A: Yes, all core features free with email-only signup.
